title: Issue-store housekeeping: stale labels and contradicted declines
cluster_summary: Six closed issues across AuraMaster (#22), PanelMaster (#47) and LibKa0s (#32, #33, #37, #39) still carry an open-only status label (state:untriaged or state:triaged). The cause is that issues get closed with a bare gh issue close or a commit keyword, and neither swaps the label. dev-copilot's issue-summary already reports a closed issue with an open-state label as an Inconsistency and deliberately leaves the fix to a person, so no upstream code change is needed. The fix is one throttled pass of label edits recorded in exceptions.tsv. A one-line rule in dev-copilot saying 'closing an issue also swaps its state label' is optional. Two closed declines that the code has since overtaken (KickCD#11, PrettyChat#8) are worth a comment each in the same GitHub pass, with their labels left alone. AT-A-12 is refuted because #26 already carries the 2026-09-24 scope comment. AT-A-17 is a healthy backlog, not a finding.

verdicts.assessment: #22 is CLOSED (shipped in 5cc04e5) but still labelled state:untriaged. That contradicts the status table in audit-review-history and inflates the untriaged counts that the issue-* commands report. The fix is one label edit.
verdicts.remediation: gh issue edit 22 -R <owner>/AuraMaster --remove-label state:untriaged --add-label state:done. Record it in exceptions.tsv with the verify command gh issue list --state closed --label state:untriaged returning []. Throttle it together with the PM and LK edits.

verdicts.assessment: #47 was CLOSED on 2026-09-26 after the work landed in 5119ae1, but it is still labelled state:triaged, which the standard binds to open issues. The fix is one label edit.
verdicts.remediation: gh issue edit 47 --remove-label state:triaged --add-label state:done. A comment citing 5119ae1 is optional. Record it in exceptions.tsv with the verify query. Throttle it.

verdicts.assessment: The query returns exactly #32, #33, #37 and #39: all closed, all labelled state:triaged, and the work is done. They distort the collection's backlog counts.
verdicts.remediation: Run gh issue edit <n> --remove-label state:triaged --add-label state:done for 32, 33, 37 and 39, spaced out. Verify that gh issue list --state closed --label state:triaged returns []. Record it in exceptions.tsv.

verdicts.assessment: #11 (a will-not-do on RenderGrid) is contradicted by e0da04c, and settings/Spells.lua and settings/General.lua now use H.RenderGrid. No rule fails and the issue is not live backlog, but a later revendor or harvest run could cite the decline as current policy.
verdicts.remediation: Add one comment to #11 saying #10 (e0da04c) superseded it after the LibKa0s gaps it named were closed. Leave it closed and keep the label. Batch it with the other GitHub writes.

verdicts.assessment: #8 declined per-character and per-realm profile scoping, but SP-PC-01's Profiles page (AceDBOptions) and the README now offer it. No rule fails, and the only person misled is someone reading closed issues.
verdicts.remediation: Add one comment to #8 saying SP-PC-01 (2026-09-29) superseded it, citing options-ui §3. Do not relabel: will-not-do records the decision as it stood. Batch it with the other GitHub writes.

verdicts.assessment: I checked this myself. #26 already has a 2026-09-24 AT-DOCS comment that limits the decline to the Widgets Dropdown and records that the DragHandle is adopted (modules/Bar.lua:15, :126-129). The staleness the finding describes is already annotated.
The eight open enhancements are correctly labelled state:triaged. That is a normal backlog, no rule is violated, and the finding's own remediation is 'None'.
